faq.how1: Pick a category with the tabs below.
faq.how2: Open a question to read the answer.
faq.elsewhereBody: Our bot commands: Wiki. Perks for all roles: Perks.
faq.q1.title: How can I earn EXP points?
faq.q1.body: Every chat message and time spent in voice channels raises your EXP (voice EXP is doubled). On PERKS you can see what unlocks at each level, while leaderboards are in COMMUNITY.
faq.q2.title: How can I join the minigames?
faq.q2.body: Every 15 minutes, from 8:00 AM to 11:59 PM, you can play small chat games sent by our bot. They are optional — if you want to have fun with others, compete, and earn extra EXP, this is for you!
faq.q3.title: Can we listen to music together?
faq.q3.body: Absolutely! In voice rooms you can listen or share what you like, respecting volume and the rules (no earrape, nothing disruptive), using our official bots. To discover every command, check the WIKI.
faq.q4.title: Which games are available?
faq.q4.body: There are many channels like Pokétwo, Counting, Ship, plus chat minigames with the bot. Not every game is for every taste — if one is not for you, just skip it.
faq.q5.title: How do seasonal events work?
faq.q5.body: While you are on the server you can join full SEASONS lasting about 3 months. Each period has a main theme with many events, contests, and challenges designed to keep you hooked!
faq.q6.title: How can I improve my chances of winning events?
faq.q6.body: Follow the event instructions carefully — they list every way to get ahead. Being active in voice and text helps a lot. For bonuses, voting and boosting usually unlock perks listed under VOTE and PERKS. There is no single shortcut: rewards go to people who join with consistency and enthusiasm!
faq.q7.title: What does "paid staff" mean?
faq.q7.body: Every month the best staff member is rewarded with one month of Nitro Boost. Partner Managers are rewarded with Nitro Boost and cash prizes based on their performance.
faq.q8.title: Can I become a staff member?
faq.q8.body: Of course! We are always looking for new people to join our team. After reading the rules carefully, submit your application through the form on this site. Seriousness and consistency matter! If you have experience, say so. After applying, do not ping staff or open tickets to ask about the outcome.

legal.privacy.s1.title: Introduction
legal.privacy.s1.body:
This Privacy Policy describes how {{SITE_NAME}} collects, uses, and protects personal data related to the website, Discord bots (including Vinili and related services such as Caffè), the configuration dashboard, and community services — including on third-party Discord servers where the bot has been invited.

Processing complies with the GDPR, applicable Italian law, and the policies of third-party services we use (in particular Discord).
legal.privacy.s2.title: Data we collect
legal.privacy.s2.body:
Data provided via Discord OAuth (website)

  • Discord ID, username, display name, and avatar (identify scope).
  • List of Discord servers where you have administrator/manage permissions, when you use the dashboard (additional guilds scope).
  • OAuth token and session data needed for site login.

Data processed by bots and the community

  • Messages, commands, reactions, and metadata needed for features such as levels/XP, tickets, moderation, minigames, events, quotes/reposts/clips, and leaderboards.
  • Partnership data (configured channels/roles, logs, invites, staff points/progress, blacklist, and history) on servers where the module is enabled.
  • Voice preferences and content when you use TTS, voice rooms, voice clips, or transcriptions (possibly processed via third-party ASR providers).
  • On dedicated servers, chat content may feed a Markov corpus for automated generated messages.
  • Vote/bump data from external platforms (e.g. top.gg, Discadia) via webhooks, linked to your Discord ID for rewards.
  • Content you voluntarily submit (reviews, applications, unban requests, tickets, forms, feedback).

Technical data and local storage

  • OAuth tokens/cache, language preference, cookie-banner acknowledgement, and other technical keys in the browser localStorage.
  • Technical logs, IP addresses, and diagnostics within the limits needed for security and reliability.
legal.privacy.s3.title: How we use data
legal.privacy.s3.body:
We use your personal data to:

  • Authenticate and manage access to the site and dashboard.
  • Provide community and bot features (profile, levels, music, TTS/voice, partnership, tickets, moderation, events, voting).
  • Configure the bot on Discord servers managed by authorized administrators.
  • Prevent fraud, abuse, unauthorized automation, and malicious behavior.
  • Protect the site, bots, infrastructure, and community.
  • Meet legal obligations and handle support, moderation, or GDPR requests.
  • Improve the stability, security, and quality of our services.
legal.privacy.s4.title: Legal basis (GDPR)
legal.privacy.s4.body:
Data processing is based on:

  • Performance of the service for login, account management, and features requested by the user.
  • Legitimate interest for community protection, abuse prevention, security, and moderation.
  • Legal obligation when required to comply with requests or regulatory duties.
  • Consent where required, for example for non-essential cookies or specific optional features.
legal.privacy.s5.title: Data sharing
legal.privacy.s5.body:
Your data is not sold. It may be shared only with parties strictly needed for the service, such as:

  • Discord Inc., for OAuth, server hosting, and platform APIs.
  • Hosting, database, and infrastructure providers that keep the site and bots online.
  • Voting/listing platforms (e.g. top.gg, Discadia) when you use or receive voting features.
  • Technical voice transcription/AI providers, only if you use clip/transcription features that require them.
  • Administrators of the Discord server you are in, for data needed to operate that server (e.g. partnership, moderation).
  • Competent authorities, if required by law or to protect the security of the service.

We do not share data with advertisers or marketing companies for independent commercial purposes.
legal.privacy.s6.title: Cookies
legal.privacy.s6.body:
We use cookies and similar technologies (including localStorage) mainly to:

  • Maintain the Discord login session (up to 90 days or until logout).
  • Remember language, UI preferences, and cookie-banner acknowledgement.
  • Protect the site with abuse controls and technical tokens.
  • Make pages and restricted areas work correctly.

For the detailed list, see the Cookie Policy.
legal.privacy.s7.title: Data security
legal.privacy.s7.body:
We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect processed data, including:

  • HTTPS/TLS connections and session protection.
  • OAuth checks (anti-CSRF state) and checks against unauthorized access.
  • Access limits to data for authorized staff only.
  • Logging, monitoring, and abuse-mitigation tools where needed.
  • Backups and infrastructure protections within the limits of the systems used.
legal.privacy.s8.title: Your rights (GDPR)
legal.privacy.s8.body:
You have the rights provided by the GDPR, within applicable limits, including access, rectification, erasure, restriction/objection, portability, and withdrawal of consent where applicable.

You can export or request deletion of data managed by the site and bots from the Your data page (Discord sign-in), and you can also contact us via Discord or email.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante).
legal.privacy.s9.title: Data retention
legal.privacy.s9.body:
We retain data for as long as needed for the purposes for which it is processed, for example:

  • As long as you remain in the server or use related services, unless deleted or anonymized.
  • Up to 90 days for the local site session, unless you log out or the token expires.
  • Partnership, points, logs, and moderation data for as long as useful for community management, disputes, and security.
  • Backups, technical logs, and legal obligations according to reasonable rotations and periods.
legal.privacy.s10.title: Minors
legal.privacy.s10.body:
The service is intended for users who meet Discord’s minimum age requirements. We do not knowingly collect personal data of minors below the minimum age allowed by the platform.

If we are informed of non-compliant collection, we may remove the data within reasonable technical and organizational limits.
legal.privacy.s11.title: International transfers
legal.privacy.s11.body:
Some services used by the project, such as Discord or other technical providers, may process data outside the European Economic Area.

When that happens, processing follows the safeguards offered by those providers and the limits set by the GDPR, including any standard contractual clauses or equivalent technical measures.
legal.privacy.s12.title: Policy changes
legal.privacy.s12.body:
We may update this Privacy Policy for legal, technical, or organizational changes. The last-updated date at the top indicates the current version.

By continuing to use the site or community services after changes are published, you acknowledge the updated version.
legal.privacy.s13.title: Contacts and complaints
legal.privacy.s13.body:
For privacy questions, GDPR requests, or reports you can contact us via Discord or email ({{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).

legal.terms.s1.body:

Continued use after updates are published constitutes acceptance of the changes.
legal.terms.s2.title: Service description
legal.terms.s2.body:
{{SITE_NAME}} offers a Discord community and related services, including:

  • A Discord server for socializing, events, support, and community activities.
  • Public/multi-server bots (music, TTS/voice, levels, tickets, moderation, partnership, utilities) that can also be configured via a web dashboard.
  • Web pages for voting, profile, roles, reviews, wiki, applications, unban, and notifications.
  • Integrations with Discord, voting platforms, and other technical providers needed for the service.

We may modify, suspend, or remove parts of the service, site, bots, or Servers at any time.
legal.terms.s3.title: Access requirements
legal.terms.s3.body:
To use our services you must:

  • Meet Discord’s minimum age and follow the Discord Terms of Service.
  • Use a valid, non-compromised Discord account.
  • Provide accurate data when submitting applications, requests, reviews, or other forms.
  • Keep your account secure and not share it to bypass checks or limits.
  • Follow these terms, the Privacy Policy, the Cookie Policy, and the server rules.
legal.terms.s4.title: Conduct rules
legal.terms.s4.body:
It is forbidden to

  • Violate applicable laws or Discord policies.
  • Post offensive, discriminatory, illegal, or harmful content.
  • Harass, threaten, intimidate, or impersonate other users or staff.
  • Use bots, scripts, multi-accounts, or abusive VPNs to fake votes, partnerships, levels, stats, or access.
  • Abuse the dashboard, APIs, vote webhooks, or migration/configuration systems.
  • Record or share others’ audio without a lawful basis, or use TTS/voice for harassment.
  • Attempt to compromise the site, bots, panels, or server security.
  • Spam, phish, run unauthorized advertising, or share third parties’ personal data.
  • Exploit bugs instead of reporting them to staff, or bypass bans/timeouts/limits.
legal.terms.s5.title: Voting system
legal.terms.s5.body:
• Votes must be genuine and compliant with the rules of external platforms (e.g. top.gg, Discadia).
  • Using bots, multi-accounts, abusive VPNs, or automated methods to obtain rewards is not allowed.
  • Points/progress/rewards may be corrected or voided in case of abuse.
  • Vote webhooks may process your Discord ID to grant rewards; third-party services may change without notice.
legal.terms.s6.title: Staff applications
legal.terms.s6.body:
• Applications are reviewed by staff at their discretion.
  • Submitting an application does not guarantee a reply, acceptance, or a staff role.
  • False information, spam, or form abuse may lead to rejection or sanctions.
  • Staff roles may be removed at any time for internal organization or violations.
  • Staff roles do not grant legal, economic, or ownership rights over the server or site.
legal.terms.s7.title: Intellectual property
legal.terms.s7.body: All site content (design, graphics, text, code, bots, logos, wiki) remains the property of {{SITE_NAME}} or the respective owners. You may not copy, resell, distribute, or reuse such content without authorization.
legal.terms.s8.title: User content
legal.terms.s8.body:
By posting messages, media, reviews, applications, or other content on the Server or Site:

  • You retain ownership of your content, subject to law or Discord policy limits.
  • You grant us a limited license needed to operate the service, moderate, publish content technically, and — where enabled — generate automated content (e.g. Markov) from public community messages.
  • You warrant that you have the right to share what you post.
  • You remain responsible for content you submit.
legal.terms.s9.title: Moderation and sanctions
legal.terms.s9.body: Staff may moderate or remove content, apply warn/timeout/kick/ban, block access obtained through abuse, and decide internal disputes. Sanctions may be temporary or permanent based on severity, context, and repeat offenses.
legal.terms.s10.title: Limitation of liability
legal.terms.s10.body:
{{SITE_NAME}} is not liable for

  • Loss of data, stats, progress, levels, preferences, or content.
  • Service interruptions, maintenance, downtime, or system changes.
  • Actions of other users, third-party content, or linked external services.
  • Indirect or consequential damages, or damages from misuse of the service.
  • Limits, changes, or unavailability imposed by Discord or third-party providers.

The service is provided "as is", without guarantees of continuous availability or specific results.
legal.terms.s11.title: Discord Terms of Service
legal.terms.s11.body: Our server is hosted on Discord. By using it you also accept the Discord Terms of Service and their Privacy Policy. If a feature depends on Discord, their rules and technical limits prevail. The length of the site login session depends on the OAuth token issued by Discord.
legal.terms.s12.title: Contacts
legal.terms.s12.body: For questions about the Terms of Service you can contact us via Discord or email ({{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}).
legal.cookie.s1.title: What are cookies?
legal.cookie.s1.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies also include browser storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) for login, preferences, and security.
legal.cookie.s2.title: Cookies we use
legal.cookie.s2.body:
Strictly necessary

We use technical cookies and local storage that are strictly necessary. Without them, login and restricted areas may not work.

Discord OAuth session — token and expiry in localStorage (up to 90 days / logout / token expiry).
Scope and profile cache — remember OAuth permissions and minimal profile data to reduce Discord API calls.
Language preference — stores the site language.
Cookie banner preference — remembers banner acknowledgement (up to 180 days).
Technical UI state — local keys for notifications, event access, or previews, without advertising profiling.

Analytics / marketing

{{SITE_NAME}} does not use advertising profiling, remarketing, or social tracking cookies (except Discord cookies during OAuth). If measurement tools or a consent banner are enabled in the future, they will be listed here and will require consent where mandatory.
legal.cookie.s3.title: Cookie security
legal.cookie.s3.body:
Our cookies use advanced protections:

  • HTTPS/TLS — encrypted communications with API services.
  • Anti-CSRF OAuth state — state verification in login callbacks.
  • Session expiry — the local session ends after at most 90 days, logout, or Discord token invalidation/expiry.
  • Minimized data — only technical data strictly needed to operate.
legal.cookie.s4.title: Cookie purposes
legal.cookie.s4.body:
We use cookies and local storage to:

  • Keep you authenticated on the site and dashboard.
  • Protect accounts and APIs from unauthorized access.
  • Prevent automated abuse.
  • Remember language and technical UI choices.
  • Support voting and restricted areas.
legal.cookie.s5.title: Legal basis
legal.cookie.s5.body: The cookies/storage we use today are strictly necessary for login, security, and site operation. Under GDPR and ePrivacy, explicit consent is not required for these essential technical items. We do not use profiling or marketing cookies.
legal.cookie.s6.title: How to manage cookies
legal.cookie.s6.body: You can manage cookies and storage in your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) or by clearing site data. Disabling essential items will block login. To remove the session, log out of the site.
legal.cookie.s7.title: Third-party cookies
legal.cookie.s7.body: During Discord OAuth authentication you may receive cookies from discord.com, managed by Discord Inc. under their Privacy Policy. {{SITE_NAME}} has no control over those cookies.
